description: Production-grade easement analysis engine providing identification, classification, and risk assessment of easements, rights-of-way, surface use agreements, and pipeline corridors for oil and gas operations across Texas and Permian Basin jurisdictions. Covers express, implied, prescriptive, and necessity easements, dominant/servient estate analysis, accommodation doctrine compliance, surface damage acts, eminent domain condemnation, and ROW width/depth engineering parameters.

layers.name: Doctrine Cache
layers.description: Pre-compiled easement doctrine for instant retrieval on common ROW, surface use, and pipeline queries

layers.name: Semantic Search
layers.description: TF-IDF inverted index search over easement doctrine blocks, statutory references, and recorded instruments

layers.name: Easement Analysis
layers.description: Structured easement analysis including type classification, scope determination, and conflict detection

layers.description: Multi-doctrine synthesis for complex easement disputes, overburdening claims, and accommodation doctrine compliance

fast.description: Quick easement identification and type classification with key statutory citations

analysis.description: Structured easement analysis with scope determination, conflict check, and accommodation doctrine review

memo.description: Full easement memorandum with comprehensive citation, risk assessment, and recommended actions

row_review.description: Pipeline ROW and surface use agreement review with engineering parameters and compliance check

condemnation_analysis.description: Eminent domain and condemnation proceeding analysis with valuation factors and procedural requirements

express.description: Granted by written instrument recorded in county records

implied_prior_use.description: Implied from prior use at time of severance when apparent, continuous, and reasonably necessary

implied_necessity.description: Created when property is landlocked and no other reasonable access exists
implied_necessity.typical_duration: perpetual (lasts as long as necessity exists)

prescriptive.description: Acquired through open, notorious, hostile, continuous use for statutory period

appurtenant.description: Benefits a specific parcel (dominant estate), burdens another (servient estate), runs with land

in_gross.description: Benefits a person or entity rather than a specific parcel, does not require dominant estate

pipeline_row.description: Right-of-way for oil, gas, or product pipelines across surface estate

surface_use.description: Agreement between mineral lessee/operator and surface owner governing surface operations

road_access.description: Access easement for ingress and egress to landlocked or remote parcels

utility.description: Easement for electric, water, sewer, telephone, or communication lines

flowage.description: Right to flood or allow water drainage across another's property

conservation.description: Restricts development to protect natural resources, habitat, or agricultural character

txdot_standards.open_cut_allowed: only with TxDOT approval for low-traffic roads

rrc_requirements.leak_survey_frequency: annual for transmission, biannual for gathering
rrc_requirements.abandonment_procedure: purge, fill, cap, mark, file Form W-1X
rrc_requirements.marker_requirements: at crossings, fences, and every 660 ft minimum

surface_damage_act.applies_to: mineral lessees and operators on non-owner surface estates
requirements: Written notice to surface owner before commencement
Good faith negotiation of surface use and damage payment
Payment of actual damages to land and improvements
Restoration of surface to as near original condition as practicable

accommodation_doctrine.source_case: Getty Oil Co. v. Jones, 470 S.W.2d 618 (Tex. 1971)
elements: Mineral estate has dominant right to use surface
But must exercise rights with due regard to surface owner
If alternative methods exist that are industry-standard
And would allow both mineral and surface use to coexist
Mineral owner must accommodate the existing surface use

row_compensation: Market value of land within easement corridor
Diminution of value to remainder parcel
surface_damage_factors: Value of crops destroyed or damaged
Cost to repair fences, roads, improvements
condemnation_just_compensation: Fair market value of property taken
Cost to cure (if cure reduces severance damage)
